name: resume-interrupted
description: ⚡️ Detects when your most recent session in a project was cut off mid-task — a crash, a dropped connection or a usage limit — and offers at startup to pick up where you left off. It never offers a session that is still running, tells you whether a limit that stopped you has reset, and recovers the context from the transcript. The `interrupted` command lists and reviews unfinished sessions.
